segments.name: LPG Distribution & Engineering
products: Engineering, installation and annual maintenance contracts
segments.description: Distributes and engineers liquefied petroleum gas in the United Arab Emirates through its operating subsidiary Al Shola Gas.
segments.evidence: The Group has identified one reportable operating segment under IFRS 8, being its LPG Distribution & Engineering business

revenueModel.text: Customers in the United Arab Emirates pay for LPG engineering, installation, bulk and cylinder LPG, metered utility supply and annual maintenance services.
revenueModel.evidence: Revenue in the United Arab Emirates is generated through Al Shola Gas, which provides engineering, installation, bulk LPG, cylinder LPG, metered utility and annual maintenance services.

changes.text: In 2024, the Group changed from a single green hydrogen segment to its LPG Distribution & Engineering segment after acquiring QIND.
changes.evidence: Prior to the acquisition of QIND in November 2024, the Group operated as a single segment focused on green hydrogen technology.

changes.text: In 2024, the former green hydrogen and electrolyzer manufacturing businesses were effectively terminated.
changes.evidence: As a result, the Company's former green hydrogen and electrolyzer manufacturing businesses have been effectively terminated.
